title: X Window System connections that are not required must be disabled.
check_content:
Determine if the X Window system is running.

Procedure:
# ps -ef |grep X

Ask the SA if the X Window system is an operational requirement. If it is not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Disable the X Windows server on the system.
VulnDiscussion: If unauthorized clients are permitted access to the X server, a user's X session may be compromised.
